title: GET /BookStore/v1/Books response
description: Response shape for the book catalogue, used by BookStoreApiTest Test 4 (getBooksList_ShouldReturnNonEmptyCatalogue). Each book's fields are inlined here rather than in a separate $ref'd fragment file — REST Assured's json-schema-validator resolves $ref against the classpath root by default, not relative to this file, which makes cross-file $ref more trouble than it's worth for just two schemas (this one and book-detail.json) sharing one small shape. If a third schema ever needs the same book shape, that's the point to extract a shared fragment and wire up a proper classpath-relative resolver.
